commit.message:
De-flake trajectory_cache _with_move_group tests, take 2 (#3859)

* De-flake trajectory_cache _with_move_group tests, take 2

test_motion_plan_request_features_with_move_group has been the recurring
failure in the jazzy-ci + ikfast job (runs 34683703000, 34819993343,
35124906659), while every other matrix entry passes on the same commits.

The test asserts that StartStateJointStateFeatures writes insert metadata.
For an is_diff start state that path calls MoveGroupInterface::getCurrentState(),
which only waits one second for a complete robot state; when it times out the
feature returns UNABLE_TO_AQUIRE_SENSOR_DATA, no metadata is written, and the
follow-on queryList assertions fail with "no such column:
M_StartStateJointStateFeatures.start_state.joint_state.name_0".

The gating added in #3777 is working: joint_state_broadcaster is activated and
publishing before the test binary launches. What remains is subscriber-side
discovery of /joint_states taking longer than a second on a loaded runner. The
fixture's own spin loop made that worse by busy-waiting at 100% CPU while
several of these tests run concurrently under ctest.

So prime the current state monitor once in SetUp() with a 10s timeout, so the
short waits inside the cache always find a populated monitor, and block in
spin_once() instead of hot-looping on spin_some(). Raise the add_ros_test
timeouts to 120s so a genuine /joint_states failure reports the assertion
message rather than being killed by the harness.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Use UPPER_CASE for the new fixture constants

clang-tidy's readability-identifier-naming requires GlobalConstantCase to be
UPPER_CASE, which is also what the rest of the trajectory_cache package uses.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
Include rviz_common/logging.hpp where RVIZ_COMMON_LOG_* is used (#3861)

* Include rviz_common/logging.hpp where RVIZ_COMMON_LOG_* is used

rolling-ci broke on main between Sep 16 (093360fef, green) and Sep 22
(b89c0482c, red) with a build failure, not a test failure:

  rviz_plugin_render_tools/src/trajectory_visualization.cpp:166:5:
    error: 'RVIZ_COMMON_LOG_WARNING' was not declared in this scope
  1 package failed: moveit_ros_visualization

No MoveIt commit in that window touches visualization. The trigger was the
weekly moveit/moveit2:rolling-ci image rebuild on Sep 19 (run 35463509686),
which moved rviz from 16.0.2-1resolute.20260821 to 16.0.3-1resolute.20260916.
That same scheduled run's source (rolling) image build already hit this error.

The upstream change is ros2/rviz#1798 ("Moved implementation to cpp", merged
2026-07-16), which removed #include "rviz_common/logging.hpp" from
rviz_common/interaction/forwards.hpp. That was the one include path by which
trajectory_visualization.cpp reached the RVIZ_COMMON_LOG_* macros:

  trajectory_visualization.cpp
    -> rviz_default_plugins/robot/robot_link.hpp
      -> rviz_common/interaction/forwards.hpp
        -> rviz_common/logging.hpp          (edge removed by #1798)

Walking the include graph of both release tarballs finds exactly one path at
16.0.2 and none at 16.0.3.

trajectory_visualization.cpp is just the first file the build reaches.
robot_state_display.cpp and interactive_marker_display.cpp have no path to
logging.hpp under 16.0.3 either and would fail as soon as the build gets past
moveit_rviz_plugin_render_tools; planning_scene_display.cpp still reaches it
via transformation_manager.hpp -> pluginlib_factory.hpp. Include the header
explicitly in all four rather than leaving three of them on an accident.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Include rviz_common/frame_manager_iface.hpp where getFrameManager() is used

Second casualty of the same rviz 16.0.3 include cleanup. With the logging.hpp
fix in place the build gets further and then fails on:

  planning_scene_display.cpp:741:30: error: invalid use of incomplete type
    'class rviz_common::FrameManagerIface'

ros2/rviz#1829 ("Cleanup headers") dropped #include "frame_manager_iface.hpp"
from display_context.hpp, so `context_->getFrameManager()->...` now sees only
the forward declaration that display_context.hpp still carries.

robot_state_display.cpp already includes the header directly and is fine.
interactive_marker_display.cpp has the same call and additionally upcasts the
shared_ptr from getTransformer(), so it needs the complete FrameTransformer
type too.

Diffing the reachable-header sets of every file under moveit_ros/visualization
between the 16.0.2 and 16.0.3 trees, five rviz headers stop being reachable:
logging.hpp, logging_handler.hpp, frame_manager_iface.hpp, frame_transformer.hpp
and ros_integration/ros_node_abstraction.hpp. Of those, only logging.hpp (the
previous commit), frame_manager_iface.hpp and frame_transformer.hpp are used by
symbol anywhere in the tree, and all are now included directly.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
